params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers may only use `view` and `embed`.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection (1-based).

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. The most effective way to keep page-body responses small on this site, where `content.rendered` can exceed 100KB.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by term attribute.

params.name: hide_empty
params.description: Whether to hide terms not assigned to any posts.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to terms assigned to a specific parent.

params.name: post
params.description: Limit result set to terms assigned to a specific post.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to terms with one or more specific slugs.

items.docs: Lists terms in the hierarchical `category` taxonomy. 10 terms at harvest time — News (94), Publication (34), Event (9), Clinical (6), Leadership (5), Board (4), Feature (2), COVID19 (1), Uncategorized (1) and Jobs (0). This taxonomy is how the site segments its content; there are no post tags.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the term.
